info.brief: Functions for creating Spine resources dynamically
info.description: Functions for creating Spine resources dynamically

elements.name: resource.create_spinescene
elements.description: Creates a spinescene resource (.spinescenec) from runtime data. Creates a Spine scene resource dynamically at runtime. This allows loading Spine animations from data rather than pre-built assets. The atlas path must reference a compiled `.texturesetc` resource. The created spinescene is tracked for cleanup when the collection unloads; internal intermediate JSON is removed automatically.

parameters.name: path
parameters.doc: The target resource path. Must end with .spinescenec

fields.name: spine_data
fields.doc: JSON bytes of the Spine skeleton

fields.name: atlas_path
fields.doc: Path to the compiled atlas resource (.texturesetc)

returnvalues.name: path_hash
returnvalues.doc: canonical path hash of the created resource
